caption: The video showcases a diagonal black track of six spotlight fixtures mounted near a ceiling, every one of them switched on and emitting a cool blue-white light against a plain wall. The glow from each lamp pools softly on the surface below, and these illuminated patches hold their shape and brightness without fluctuation. In the lower-left corner, a Japanese smart-lighting control panel remains overlaid, headed by the group list label and showing two named groups, a living-room lighting row with a white color swatch and a table-light row with a red swatch. Each row keeps its ON/OFF toggle and color-switch buttons visible and unchanged. The camera framing stays fixed, with the track, ceiling line, and overlay holding constant positions relative to one another. No lighting state changes occur, leaving the scene in a steady all-on condition for the entire duration.
relations: Six spotlights on the diagonal track remain switched on, emitting steady cool blue-white light against the wall.
The illuminated patches pooling on the surface below hold their shape and brightness without fluctuation.
The lower-left control panel overlay remains fixed, showing two named groups with visible toggles and color swatches.
The camera framing stays constant, with the track, ceiling line, and overlay holding fixed relative positions.
